visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark brown hair and a white t-shirt sits at a wooden desk, looking directly at the camera with an expressive face. The background shows a white wall with horizontal grey stripes and a display case filled with figurines. (2) She reaches down and pulls up a large white patterned gift bag with handles, holding it up to the camera with a surprised and happy expression. (3) The woman holds up several packaged boxes from the Chiikawa Ichiban Kuji series, including the B, C, E, and G prizes, showing them to the viewer. (4) Close-up shots of the G prize stationery items; she holds a pack of three colorful memo pads featuring Chiikawa, Hachiware, and Usagi, then shows a pink postcard with bath-themed illustrations. (5) She demonstrates the E prize glass and milk bottle; she pours a white liquid from a carton into the small glass which has colorful character prints on it, then displays a matching glass milk bottle. (6) Detail shots of the C prize storage box, which is designed like a milk vending machine with transparent windows; she holds two small vinyl figures of Kurimanju and Usagi, then places them next to the box. (7) Detailed look at the B prize, a brown storage container styled like an onsen reception desk with Chiikawa and Hachiware figures peeking out; she attaches a small yellow sign to the front and places pens inside to show its function. (8) The woman returns to the eye-level shot, holding several of the unboxed items and smiling widely, while a mobile chat screenshot appears as an overlay at the bottom of the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice greeting the audience over an upbeat, bouncy electronic BGM. A subtle rustling sound of a large plastic bag accompanies her initial excitement. (2) As she introduces the 'G prize,' a crisp 'pop' sound effect punctuates the transition. The BGM maintains a steady, happy rhythm. (3) When showing the stationery, a paper rustling noise is heard, followed by a soft metallic 'ding' as she highlights the embossed detail. Her speech rate is fast and energetic. (4) A distinctive clinking sound of glass occurs as she reveals the E prize cup. This is immediately followed by the continuous, bubbling sound of liquid being poured into the glass, lasting about two seconds. (5) The presentation of the 'C prize' involves the sound of a plastic box being opened and the subtle clicking of small vinyl figures being placed on a hard surface. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (6) For the 'B prize,' a noticeable 'whoosh' transition sound effect is used. The speaker's tone becomes more dramatic and playful. (7) Final segment features a mix of the ongoing bubbly BGM and the speaker expressing gratitude with high vocal arousal. A final digital UI 'notification' sound effect closes the video track.
